messages:
maria (Finance): Quick heads-up — proposing a small A/B dry-run for migrating legacy free credits into a subscription credit bucket. Goal: detect billing/invoice fallout before full rollout.

ben (Billing): +1. what cohort size are we thinking? also need to confirm how open invoices with credits are rendered in QuickBooks.

sophia (Product): Prefer a conservative start — 5% of active paying customers, randomized by account_id. Keep 2-week observation window.

ajay (Revenue Ops): 5% sounds good. Can we exclude enterprise customers and any active trials? also recommend excluding accounts with pending disputes/refunds.

maria (Finance): Yes exclude enterprise & trials. Exclude any invoice with status IN_DISPUTE or REFUND_PENDING. I added a short SQL to select candidates:

```
select account_id, sum(credit_balance) as credits, count(open_invoices) as open_invoices
from billing.account_balances
where account_tier != 'enterprise' and trial_active = false
and invoice_status not in ('IN_DISPUTE','REFUND_PENDING')
group by account_id
order by credits desc;
```

maria (Finance): We need billing to simulate invoice rendering for these accounts and legal to confirm messaging for grandfathering. @kate can you review the proposed language?

kate (Legal): I skimmed the draft. Two things: 1) call out that credits expire only when customer explicitly accepts subscription conversion, otherwise we keep current behavior; 2) add a short line about tax treatment — doing a conversion shouldn't be treated as additional consideration. I'll send suggested wording.

billing-bot: stripe-webhook: invoice.created (sample) — duplicate webhook detected for acct_0x123 — marked as deduped.

ben (Billing): For the dry-run, I'll run a render job to create preview invoices (no posting) and share a CSV with columns: account_id, old_credit_balance, preview_line_items, tax_amount. Expecting to run that tonight.

ajay (Revenue Ops): What are our rollback criteria? revenue delta > 2%? spike in failed invoice webhooks? increased support volume?

maria (Finance): Proposed gates: 1) Net revenue delta across cohort <= 1.5% over baseline, 2) Failed invoice webhook rate change < 0.5pp, 3) Support tickets related to billing for cohort < 10 per 1k accounts. If any gate trips, we pause rollout.

sophia (Product): Add a soft gate for customer sentiment — negative NPS mentions > 5% in sampled accounts and we rollback.

ben (Billing): Running previews now. Two quick asks: a) how do we handle existing pro-rated credits on partially paid invoices? I'll mark them as "hold" in the preview; b) should previews include a separate 'grandfathering' line item? ops needs it for clarity.

maria (Finance): Yes include a separate line item: `GRANDFATHERED_CREDIT_TRANSFER` with memo linking to experiment id. That will make reconciliation easier.

kate (Legal): That line item language is fine. Also ensure customers who opt out get full credit preserved.

ben (Billing): Uploaded preview CSV to the sheet: https://go.redwood/revops/credits-migration-dryrun (view only). Sample rows look good. Found ~420 accounts with edge-case pro-rates.

ajay (Revenue Ops): I'll run the cohort randomizer and post the final A/B list by EOD. Also prepping the metric dashboard: revenue, MRR delta, webhook errors, invoice failure rate, tickets.

maria (Finance): Ops question — how will refunds be handled if conversion happens after a refund request? Are credits applied post-refund? @ben

ben (Billing): If a refund is initiated, original invoice lifecycle wins — we won't auto-apply converted credits to past refunds. We need a manual adjustment workflow for refunds that reference migrated credits. I'll add a note to the runbook.

sophia (Product): Can we add a brief in-console banner for affected accounts explaining the dry-run and how to opt-out? simple copy + link to support.

kate (Legal): Keep banner wording neutral and opt-out prominent. Don't imply action without consent.

maria (Finance): Next steps checklist: 
- Ben: run preview and upload CSV (in progress)
- Ajay: finalize cohort and dashboard (ETA EOD)
- Kate: legal copy suggestions (ETA 24h)
- Sophia: draft in-console banner and opt-out flow (ETA 48h)
- Maria: prepare accounting entries for deferred revenue mapping and migration journal (ETA 48h)

ben (Billing): Preview done, shared comments on 12 accounts that need manual edge handling. No major invoice format issues.

ajay (Revenue Ops): Cohort posted: 5% randomized seed. Dashboard linked in sheet. I'll monitor gates and ping #incident-ops if anything spikes.

maria (Finance): Great — let's reconvene tomorrow 10:30am PT to review preview findings and sign off for a limited live canary (10k accounts or 5% whichever smaller).

sophia (Product): 👍 thanks everyone.

ben (Billing): 👍 will be on the call.

kate (Legal): I'll be there.

billing-bot: scheduled job: preview-invoice-render completed. 418 accounts processed.

maria (Finance): Closing note — keep the comms short for customers. We only want to surface the opt-out and a help link. No mention of A/B.

ajay (Revenue Ops): Understood. I'll redact experiment labels in user-visible text.

maria (Finance): Thanks team, see you tomorrow.
